PC: Check for response, recognize unresponsiveness and call for help
Check for a pulse, recognize pulselessness and start chest compressions
Open airway, turn on oxygen, attach Bag-Valve-Mask (BVM) Device, and begin ventilations
Attach pads and place backboard under patient
Turn on and set defibrillator correctly
Resume Compressions, start timing, and draw up correct drug dosages
Continue Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) and search for reversible causes of arrest
